title: English Practice Quiz 0805
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: She ___ to work every day.
questions.explanation: With he, she or it in the present simple, add -s or -es to most verbs.

questions.question: By next June, he ___ the course.
questions.explanation: The future perfect describes an action completed before a future time.

questions.question: She is interested ___ music.
questions.explanation: The adjective interested is followed by in.

questions.question: Which word has the /ʃ/ sound as in 'ship'?
Which sentence uses the apostrophe correctly?
options: The guards' uniform is blue. (one guard)
questions.explanation: Guard's shows possession by one guard.

questions.question: He said, 'I am tired.' Reported speech:
options: He said that he was tired.
questions.explanation: In standard backshift, am changes to was after a past reporting verb.

questions.question: I want ___ English fluently.
questions.explanation: Want is followed by a to-infinitive.

questions.question: She ___ in this hospital for five years.
questions.explanation: The present perfect can describe a situation continuing to the present.

questions.question: We have a meeting ___ Monday.
questions.explanation: Use on with days and dates.

questions.question: Which word has a silent 'k'?
questions.explanation: The k in know is silent.
